enrichment.headline: Gives Data Media Services 62 more days, to Feb. 28, 2026, on Prescott Elementary security upgrades
enrichment.summary: This change order extends the contractor's deadline for the Prescott Elementary School security improvement project from December 28, 2025, to February 28, 2026, which is 62 more calendar days. The text says the extra time is needed because of administrative coordination and the contractor's delayed start of staffing, as its staff were committed to other District projects. No money is added, and all other contract terms stay the same.
